value.name: Asha hides the pad
value.description: Asha slips the folded pad into her jacket pocket, concealing the room number and attending's name.
evidence: the pad folded once and slid into the inner pocket of her jacket where the room number and the attending's name went out of sight

value.name: Asha intercepts the child on the stairs
value.description: Asha moves to the foot of the stairs and meets the boy on the third step before Claire can fully rise.
evidence: She crossed to the foot of the stairs before Claire had finished pushing herself up from the table, and met the older one—a boy in mismatched pajama pants, hair flattened on one side—at the third step from the bottom

value.name: Claire moves to make tea
value.description: Claire shifts toward the kettle, taking on the task she can still manage.
evidence: Behind her Claire was already moving toward the kettle the way a person moves when she has been given one task she can still perform

value.name: Asha notes hospital and paperwork barriers
value.description: The scene establishes that the hospital is forty minutes away and that Claire lacks the signed paperwork needed to bring a non-spouse onto the unit.
evidence: The hospital was a forty-minute drive at this hour, the unit would not let a non-spouse onto the floor without paperwork Claire had not signed

value.name: Boy looks for his father
value.description: The boy on the stairs looks toward the kitchen, expecting to find his father whose car is absent.
evidence: the boy on the stairs was looking past Asha toward the kitchen for the father whose car was not in the driveway

value.name: Asha guides the boy toward the kitchen
value.description: Asha places a hand on the boy's shoulder and turns him toward the kitchen, positioning herself to block the stairs.
evidence: Asha set her palm lightly on the boy's shoulder where it met the collar of his pajama top and turned him by that small pressure toward the kitchen
She kept her body angled between him and the table where the pad had been

value.name: Asha speaks calmly to the boy
value.description: Using an ordinary morning voice, Asha asks the boy whether he wants his toast cut in halves or quarters.
evidence: asked him, in the ordinary voice she used for ordinary mornings, whether he wanted the toast cut in halves or in quarter
